svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 920 x 110 x 1 mm. Fold a 10 mm foot along one long edge at 90

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: degrees; the fin is then 100 deep below the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 3.3 mm through the foot at 150 pitch, 5 mm from the fold

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (seven holes, the first 20 from each end).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the foot lies flat on the underside of the plate. Fins at 50

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pitch, the outer ones 40 from the east and west plate edges, 30

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the north and south edges. Feet point toward the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bond each foot with high-temperature epoxy (rated 120 C or more),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then rivet through the plate with 3.2 mm closed-end aluminium

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rivets, heads on the top (wetted) face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the fin stands square to the plate within 2 degrees.
